caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately shaped dark metal object on a light beige or off-white background. The object is vertically oriented and features a symmetrical design with prominent, curved extensions at both its upper and lower ends, resembling stylized scrolls or hooks. There are several small circular holes distributed along its body, with one centrally located at each of the curved extensions and a couple more along its length. The central part of the object is rounded, and a straight rectangular segment protrudes to the right side, giving the object an appearance that suggests it may be a decorative hinge or metal fitting. The texture of the object is shaded to indicate a metallic surface, and the edges are defined but slightly irregular. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered using shades of black and gray, and it is centered on the otherwise unmarked background. In the bottom left corner, there is a faint handwritten signature.
title: Pa. German Butt of Side Hinge
